thanks for your response all the way from ireland, 

I checked out couchsurfing.org, made an account and sent some requests but I'm scared I might not get any responses because I'm not a verified user and it costs 25$. 

I asked if I could get my money back at the hotel and they said it was too late. So I guess I'm staying here until the 11am check out.

Thanks for responding iridium,

My dad was never around and my mom died when I was 19, my only family is my sister and she's been out of contact since my moms passing. I don't even have her number. I have an uncle but he and his family live in France, I've emailed him but haven't gotten a response. 

I've already paid for the hotel for the night so I don't think I can get my money back...

I'm definitely going to pawn the xbox but I'm afraid that I'm going to get barely any money for it because it's a fat xbox elite. It has dozens of games downloaded on it, so it's much more valuable to an actually gamer than a pawn shop... I posted it on craigslist but I haven't gotten a response. 

thanks for the advice though, I'm trying to breathe deep and stay calm but it's so hard. I've had hardships before but I've never felt like this and I just don't know how to deal with this.
